description: An 8-bit parallel-in, serial-out shift register — reads 8 digital inputs (D0-D7) and shifts them out one bit at a time.
how_to_use: PL (parallel load, active low), CP (serial clock), CE (clock enable, active low) are the control pins the microcontroller drives — a bit-banged protocol, not a real I2C/SPI bus. D0-D7 are the 8 parallel inputs (not interchangeable — each reads a specific external signal). Q7 is the serial output read by the microcontroller (or chained to the next unit's DS pin); Q7_N is the inverted output, usually unused. To daisy-chain: wire each unit's Q7 to the next unit's DS, share PL/CP across all units, and only the final unit's Q7 goes to the microcontroller.
